reviews.title: THEY RUINED THIS APP
reviews.text: This *used to be* an awesome app, but they changed their policies and now the ONLY way to make a video is to give them full & unrestricted access to your entire photo library!  This is unacceptable; it is a complete violation of privacy, and totally unnecessary for the app’s functionality.  For years, I had the ability to grant permission for specific photos and videos to be used to create a Relive action video.  Now I am blocked out of an app that I *PAID* for!  There is no way to contact the developer; they’re hiding behind their AI bots for any interaction.

reviews.title: Good App Concept, Mediocre Execution
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Relive app, on and off, in both its free and paid versions, for a couple of years now. The concept of the app is great, and the free version does a pretty good job of letting users get an idea of what they can get from this app. Unfortunately, that’s about where the fun stops, as the app really falls apart beyond the free version. The interface is incredibly clunky and imprecise, painfully slow, and the premium options are shockingly thin and badly designed. The interface is so badly designed that it arguably makes the app run frustratingly worse once you pay for the premium features.

reviews.title: When it works
reviews.text: The app is great when it works. However 1 in 5 it will crash and lose the ride data. Highly disappointing since I am paying for the app. Probably won’t renew. Now it doesn’t even load without strong internet connections. Seems kind of stupid that an app intended for tracking outdoor activities in the backcountry would not work without strong cell service. It used to I’ve been trying to find how to contact the creator to see what the problem is, but there’s no one to contact apparently. Canceling subscription today.

reviews.title: No longer usable
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Relive has decided that they will only allow you to use the app, even if you’re paying for it, if you give them complete access to your entire photo collection. I can only assume that they use this to sell your data to other companies. At one time they allowed access to just the photos taken during the activity, but that seems to no longer be the case. I would say to avoid this app. There are other others.

reviews.title: I miss this app!
reviews.text: This app used to be AMAZING but they keep sabotaging every possible feature so that they can lock it behind a paywall. It’s so slimy and underhanded. I understand limiting some functions like number of photos to encourage users to switch to the premium version but trimming your route and changing the title should still be baseline features. If the app worked better, I would happily purchase premium but the way things are going… it’s only a matter of time before they remove features from premium as well to force your hand into getting a new “super plus premium” membership that’s twice the price.

reviews.title: Updates removed features
reviews.text: I have used the paid version for several years but will be unsubscribing. Features in previous versions that I found useful have disappeared in the latest version. It used to be easy to view and trim a downloaded video inside Relive, but that feature is gone. It used to be easy to trim an entire Relive.  That feature was especially useful if I forgot to end the Relive recording at the end of a ride or hike and unintentionally recorded a piece of the car ride  back home from the trail head. But that feature is gone now too.

reviews.title: Frustrated long time premium member
reviews.text: I’m so frustrated with you guys. I keep paying for premium hoping that you’ll add more customization and features, and finally adding sound to the videos was great, but now I can’t control how long the videos I add are, and am limited to the length they can be? I have been using Relive and shouting you guys out on my YouTube channel, but I’m about to give up because of this last update. I was able to work around it before, by adding short clips of my videos to get the pin, then just custom adding my own videos to the map in third-party software to add sound, but now I can’t even do that. It has cost me so much time and money trying to figure out how to cut it all together that it’s not even worth using at this point.

reviews.title: WORST APP!  Don’t waste $
reviews.text:
This is the worst app. In theory, it’s cool, but it disconnects every 2 seconds. While AllTrails and Strava remain connected and you have full or enough bars, relive continuously disconnects and doesn’t make a sound to even tell you that’s it’s disconnected so you have to watch it like a hawk, put your safety in jeopardy, and hope that it tracks your route and miles. I have contacted their customer service and they try to blame it on the user immediately and their connectivity. Like I said, how can other tracker apps stay connected the whole time but anytime relive is being used even simultaneously it disconnects at least half a dozen times, if not more. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THE PRO VERSION. I did that once and it was a waste of money. Terrible app, terrible customer service.

Just finished my workout and Strava & AllTrails stayed fully connected for my entire 5.35 mile route. Relive disconnected 7 times and only tracked 4.8 miles. Make it make sense. You can’t because you app is WORTHLESS AND TERRIBLE. Shame on you! Scammers!

reviews.title: I want to love it, but…

reviews.title: A buggy mess
reviews.text:
I’m not sure when but this app was recently updated and apparently quality assurance is not something being done anymore. Anyone that spends any amount of time trying to create a video with this current update will have a plentiful list of issues and bugs.

I could easily list 10 to 15 critical defects that should have been caught prior to release, but then I’d be doing their job for them. Besides, they absolutely know they’re there and chose to release it like this anyway (these are not subtle, minor issues, but crashes, duplication of data, misidentified pictures, etc.)

It honestly makes you wonder what went wrong with the company that they would allow a release like this to be made available to their users. We’re essentially using a beta development build here.

reviews.title: Need to fix this flaw in the new Relive
reviews.text:
One function has gotten worse.
— That is “Set Location” which I use many times when creating videos.  The movement of the slider at the bottom is not acceptable.  
For example, I wished to place a photo at Mile 15 from a group bike ride.  “Set Location” always starts from the start.  Previously I was able to place my finger on the map and very quickly move to mile 15, like within a few seconds.  Now (I timed it) it took one minute, 50 seconds to get to Mile 15.  Each swipe by my finger only moves .1 or .2 mile on the route!
It will take me a long time to create my latest group bike ride as a Relive.  I always manually place 95% of the photos myself. 
That’s because the Relive app by itself is very inaccurate with its attempts at placement.
Please fix this problem.  
Relive user for many years

reviews.title: Unfair play
reviews.text:
I used to like this app a lot because it created nice videos about my rides with some statistics like top speed or max attitude, however, recently I noticed that those things are no longer presented on the free videos and now it’s also asks you each time to subscribe to the page version, and you constantly need to opt out out of it, which was a little easier previously. I understand they’re trying to push for subscription, but there are some more subtle ways to do it and also things that were free before should not become unavailable, they should bring new value add features to justify the subscription, but not take away what was used to be free…
At this point, it’s just a glorified mapping of the experience  with an orbital effect.
[Update]: to Relive “Some customization features that used to be free are now part of Relive Plus” is exactly my frustration with you move. Taking away something that was free DOES NOT improve the app. You want to improve the app? Keep what was free -> Free.
Bring any and exceptional features the will captivate your users to subscribe to the paid version!

reviews.text: Have been using this app for years and enjoyed it but recent changes are making me change my mind. It now takes three inputs to start a workout. When I’m starting, I don’t want to go through multiple steps. I’m getting started and should just have a quick start button on the main page. When I occasionally post a 3d video to share with friends on Facebook, it now just posts a link to the video and nobody likes following links from there. It used to post the video directly there.

reviews.title: Trim Route Default (Please Fix)
reviews.text: Was a great app but need the ability to edit and trim routes or I can’t share my rides or even use the app. Many times I leave the app going till I know I’m done riding. This leave me and others with no ability to get real data later on without a terminate trim edit ability. Without trim the app is useless seeing as it leaves some data without a way to recover needed data.

reviews.title: Requires too much invasive information to work
reviews.text: I have used this app for years.  When it started charging for the ability to keep adding photos to activities I said sure.  Now that it requires access to my entire photo library in order to take photos while in the middle of the activity I am done.  I’m going to quit my subscription and use one of the other apps available out there.  Since I’ve signed up for a year, hopefully Apple can pro rate me a refund as this app is now unusable in my opinion unless I grant them access to my 15k photos.  I’ll have to file a complaint with Apple and deal with that nonsense now.  What a joke.

reviews.title: Invasive data collection/watermark
reviews.text:
Reduce the amount of data collected by this app or anonymize the data before collecting. There is no reason to have so many collected data points personally linked to your paying customers. 

Remove the watermark for paying customers.

Add more user control over angle/perspective of the camera. Most of the time the default is sufficient, but recently it has chosen some very odd camera positions when visualizing hikes up a mountain.

App since v6.1.15 “requires” full access to photo library in order to save a video. This seems excessive, intrusive, and false.
